images.seen: A ridgeback sitting at the driveway gate at frosty dusk, breath visible, orange-to-navy clear gradient over the trees, frost on the lawn, warm window lit behind. Tuesday.
lines: Frost already forming and the sun barely down: tonight means business.
Even the guard dog's breath is showing, and the stars are not even out yet.
A clear dusk on the Highveld is just the frost clearing its throat.

images.seen: Towels frosted stiff on the washing line at orange dusk, frosted lawn and aloes, terracotta-roofed house behind. Monday.
lines: The towels went out damp and are coming in as boards.
Sunset is doing the colours; the frost is already doing the towels.
That washing is not dry; it is preserved. Winter dusk works fast out here.

images.seen: Five friends in beanies and blankets around a modern concrete fire bowl at clear dusk, mugs steaming, modern double-storey house behind. Friday.
lines: Clear sky, sharp air, one fire bowl doing the work of a whole summer.
The temperature dropped with the sun and the circle got tighter by exactly that much.
The evening turned cold the minute it turned beautiful, which is the usual trade.

images.seen: A frosted sports field at dusk with floodlights on, folded blankets on the bench, a ball on the white grass, clubhouse and orange horizon behind. Saturday.
lines: A sky that clean means the field freezes before the floodlights even warm up.
Frost on the pitch an hour after sundown — whoever trains tonight earns it.
The blankets on the bench are not decoration; the touchline is minus something.
